set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 10.

Problem:
RegisteredTaskLauncher.remoteScriptLaunchBytes (worker/RegisteredTaskLauncher.scala:1252-1260) writes the element exit status with:
  printf %s\\n "$status" >$temporary
  mv -f $temporary $exitPath
AtomicFiles documents "private CREATE_NEW temporary files, content force before publication, and ATOMIC_MOVE". The generated script uses a fixed temporary name (${exitStatus}.tmp), not a private one, and never syncs. scriptAttempt is deterministic in (key, source, invocation), so a Slurm requeue of the same element reuses the same .tmp path and can race.

ADR-0011 states the element exit artifact has higher authority than aggregate Slurm accounting, so it deserves the same discipline as the Scala-side publisher.

Also: umask 077 (:1256) is set after stdout/stderr are created, so those two files get the inherited umask while every other artifact is 0600. Harmless today because the directory is 0700, but inconsistent.

Acceptance:
- Temporary path is process-private and created without clobbering an existing file.
- Content is flushed/synced before the rename where the target shell supports it.
- umask is set before any redirect creates a file.
- A test asserts the generated script text for the private temporary, the ordering of umask, and the atomic move.
set.title: P6f.37: Apply the kernel atomic-publication contract to generated exit artifacts
